scope.intended_use: Provide a sunflower-inspired one-piece tray for decorative storage of dry, non-food items on a stable indoor surface.
scope.user_context: Adult dry-indoor home use; handled for placement, emptying and dry cleaning.
variants: v0.2.0 post-cleanup Step1X geometry-only digital prototype
out_of_scope: commercial release before physical and legal approval

entities.name: Pinned Kobra 3 Max PETG baseline process

interfaces.name: Tray print seat and support footprint to indoor surface

evidence.uncertainty_note: The old Anycubic 3MF metadata resolves to approximately 80 mm diameter and 6 mm thickness; the owner confirmed that this disc foot is intentional. No legacy mesh geometry is reused.

failure_modes.mode: Tray rocks, tips or has insufficient bed contact
failure_modes.effect: Contents spill or the print fails
failure_modes.mitigation: Union the owner-confirmed parametric disc foot, measure the footprint and run a loaded physical tilt/rocking test.

acceptance_criteria: Manufacturing mesh has min Z = 0 and one continuous 80 mm disc bed-contact region.
Empty tray does not rock on a verified flat plate.
Loaded tray remains upright at a 10 degree quasistatic tilt.

interfaces.name: Open tray depression to lightweight dry contents

evidence.uncertainty_note: The visible depression and 200 mm envelope are design requirements; usable volume and retention have no physical measurement.

failure_modes.mode: Generated geometry closes or shallows the depression or creates trapped pockets
failure_modes.effect: The object no longer functions as a useful tray or is difficult to clean
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect sections and top view, enforce one open depression and exclude fluid-containment claims.

acceptance_criteria: A continuous open depression is visible in sections and the slicer preview.
Representative dry items can be placed and removed by hand without snagging.

interfaces.name: Adult hand to reachable petal rim

evidence.uncertainty_note: The image shows rounded petals, but the generated edge radii and printed surface have not been measured or touched.

failure_modes.mode: Thin or sharp generated petal tip
failure_modes.effect: Minor scratch, snag or local breakage
failure_modes.mitigation: Reject knife edges digitally and require physical edge-comfort inspection before release.

acceptance_criteria: No zero-thickness or disconnected petal tips in the manufacturing mesh.
Physical prototype passes a hand-edge and snag inspection.

drivers: INT=2: Support, dry-content containment and hand-contact interfaces require separate checks.
REQ=2: Envelope, disc foot, usable depression and edge quality impose several quantitative or testable requirements.
GEO=2: The flower is organic and appearance-led but its functional regions are not precision fits.

blocking_unknowns: physical base stability and rocking result
final outgoing licence, seller identity and human commercial approvals

criticality.rationale: Within the dry non-food decorative scope, credible failures are a failed print, lost storage function, a small spill of lightweight items or a minor scratch.

decision.rationale: Proceed with the selected post-cleanup geometry-only Step1X run, uniform millimetre registration and the owner-confirmed 80 × 6 mm parametric disc only. Do not repair or reconstruct the flower body. Keep topology and slicer acceptance controlled downstream; physical and commercial release remain blocked.

warnings.message: Single-image Step1X depth and underside are generated proposals and must be inspected rather than treated as reconstruction evidence.
Only a recorded geometry-only Step1X run at or after fork commit f00dd46 may enter the new chain; training-data provenance and image-provider terms remain product-local warnings.
Stability, edge comfort, snag resistance and physical print quality are not yet tested.

next_actions.action: Generate and archive a new prompt-bound sunflower plate and post-cleanup geometry-only Step1X run.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Input, prompt, image record, runtime profile, API schema, raw GLB and step1x-run.json are product-local and hashed.

next_actions.action: Register the generated proposal for a 200 mm envelope and add only the owner-confirmed 80 × 6 mm parametric disc foot.
next_actions.exit_criterion: One watertight body passes protected-region, topology, bounds, bed-contact, depression and exact-profile supported slicer checks.

next_actions.action: Print and physically inspect the full prototype.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Rocking/tilt, dry-item use, edge-comfort and snag checks pass on the recorded machine/material/nozzle/profile.
